chunks.l2:
[tal-a09-v01] Now the classification of principles is described in detail, as arrived in order.

[tal-a09-v10] Inertness is dependence on a knower; even self-realization has no causality except through agency.

[tal-a09-v02] The forms formerly spoken shine as the supreme light-dense god, one Shiva; again from the essence of his freedom, when difference shines forth from Shiva-status, that supreme manifold-following form becomes this principle of the lord in teaching.

[tal-a09-v03] Thus indeed, from the time-abode to the end of Virabhadra city, earth-nature manifests from firmness, hardness, weight, and similar qualities.

[tal-a09-v04] Thus in water and other principles, up to Sadashiva, it is to be stated: in its own effect, in a flood of qualities, or also in its own similar quality.

[tal-a09-v05] Each principle stands in common form through pervading nature, in order, from earth-pradhana to purusha, Shiva, and others.

[tal-a09-v06] No consequence would arise for bodies and worlds; this was stated by the supreme lord in the Matanga scripture and others.

[tal-a09-v07] There, the cause-effect relation imagined by Shiva's will is shown as seen in the view of siddhayogīśvarī.

[tal-a09-v08] In reality Shiva, supreme lord of all beings, alone acts; dependent agency never arises.

[tal-a09-v09] Freedom belongs to the pure-consciousness-bodied supreme lord, while inertness is not free; thus they mutually contradict.
chunks.sanskrit: [and]-:C9 śrītantrālokasya navamamāhnikam atha tattvapravibhāgo vistarataḥ kathyate kramaprāptaḥ yānyuktāni purāṇyamūni vividhaibhadairyadeṣvanvitaṃ rūpaṃ bhāti paraṃ prakāśaniviḍaṃ devaḥ sa ekaḥ śivaḥ / tatsvātantryarasātpunaḥ śivapadādbhede vibhāte paraṃ yadrūpaṃ bahudhānugāmi tadidaṃ tattvaṃ vibhoḥ śāsane tathāhi kālasadanādvīrabhadrapurāntagam / dhṛtikāṭhinyagarimādyavabhāsāddharātmatā evaṃ jalāditattveṣu vācyaṃ yāvatsadāśive / svasminkārye@tha dharmaughe yadvāpi svasadṛgguṇe āste sāmānyakalpena tananādvyāptṛbhāvataḥ / tattattvaṃ kramaśaḥ pṛthvīpradhānaṃ puṃśivādayaḥ dehānāṃ bhuvanānāṃ ca na prasaṅgastato bhavet / śrīmanmataṅgaśāstrādau taduktaṃ parameśinā tatraiṣāṃ darśyate dṛṣṭaḥ siddhayogīśvarīmate / kāryakāraṇabhāvo yaḥ śivecchāparikalpitaḥ vastutaḥ sarvabhāvānāṃ karteśānaḥ paraḥ śivaḥ / asvatantrasya kartṛtvaṃ nahi jātūpapadyate svatantratā ca cinmātravapuṣaḥ parameśituḥ / svatantraṃ ca jaḍaṃ ceti tadanyonyaṃ virudhyate jāḍyaṃ pramātṛtantratvaṃ svātmasiddhimapi prati / na kartṛtvādṛte cānyat kāraṇatvaṃ hi labhyate

chunks.l2:
[tal-a09-v11] When that exists, its nature is life dependent on it; how can that be among independent beings abiding in self?

[tal-a09-v12] If he is first and then later, and prior and posterior are not distinct in nature, then if they are equal, something remains.

[tal-a09-v13] In that one reality of seed and sprout, would pot and cloth stand in causal relation? No.

[tal-a09-v14] If change proceeds through seed, sprout, and leaf, a nature unlike that cannot coherently belong.

[tal-a09-v15] If it were simply that nature, seed and sprout alone would not be the final resting point.

[tal-a09-v16] Even if a variegated form is granted, inert matter cannot contain mutually opposed forms.

[tal-a09-v17] If sequence is granted for inert form, sequence itself is not something beyond the being's own form.

[tal-a09-v18] If only perception remains, perception itself is of consciousness-nature.

[tal-a09-v19] If perception occurs in sequence, no separate sequence is found beyond that perception.

[tal-a09-v20] If it is own-nature, sequence cannot be something beyond that own form.
chunks.sanskrit: [and]-tasminsati hi tadbhāva ityapekṣaikajīvitam / nirapekṣeṣu bhāveṣu svātmaniṣṭhatayā katham sa pūrvamatha paścātsa iti cetpūrvapaścimau / svabhāve@natiriktau cetsama ityavaśiṣyate bījamaṅkura ityasmin satattve hetutadvatoḥ / ghaṭaḥ paṭaśceti bhavet kāryakāraṇatā na kim bījamaṅkurapatrāditayā pariṇameta cet / atatsvabhāvavapuṣaḥ sa svabhāvo na yujyate sa tatsvabhāva iti cet tarhi bījāṅkurā nije / tāvatyeva na viśrāntau tadanyātyantasaṃbhavāt tataśca citrākāro@sau tāvānkaścitprasajyate / astu cet na jaḍe@nyonyaviruddhākārasaṃbhavaḥ krameṇa citrākāro@stu jaḍaḥ kiṃ nu viruddhyate / kramo@kramo vā bhāvasya na svarūpādhiko bhavet tathopalambhamātraṃ tau upalambhaśca kiṃ tathā / upalabdhāpi vijñānasvabhāvo yo@sya so@pi hi kramopalambharūpatvāt krameṇopalabheta cet / tasya tarhi kramaḥ ko@sau tadanyānupalambhataḥ svabhāva iti cennāsau svarūpādadhiko bhavet / svarūpānadhikasyāpi kramasya svasvabhāvataḥ

chunks.l2:
[tal-a09-v21] If manifestation is by freedom, we say nothing else: holy Shiva alone is called the doer.

[tal-a09-v22] His doership is manifestation of such measure, and cause-effect relation follows from it.

[tal-a09-v23] As cloth appears with pot, immediacy after pot appears too, but that is free from fixed rule.

[tal-a09-v24] Therefore we call that the cause when, by rule, it appears immediately after, with greater form-connection present.

[tal-a09-v25] And restriction is such-form-appearance-only-essence — sprout from seed, thus appearance, not always.

[tal-a09-v26] Yogi-will-immediately-arisen such sprout, because — in the desired, of such form, restriction appears, because.

[tal-a09-v27] In dream, of jar cloth and the rest, cause-effect-nature appears by necessity alone, without contradiction, to that extent.

[tal-a09-v28] Then as far as such-form rule, obstruction-free, appears — to that extent, from such-form, firm cause-effect nature.

[tal-a09-v29] In such state and in necessity, cause-that-ness-making — in reality, of consciousness only is causality, indeed all-pervading.

[tal-a09-v30] Therefore indeed in pot-arising, aggregate is said cause — and aggregate of all, if one body is not accepted.
chunks.sanskrit: [and]-svātantryādbhāsanaṃ syāccet kimanyadbrūmahe vayam / itthaṃ śrīśiva evaikaḥ karteti paribhāṣyate kartṛtvaṃ caitadetasya tathāmātrāvabhāsanam / tathāvabhāsanaṃ cāsti kāryakāraṇabhāvagam yathā hi ghaṭasāhityaṃ paṭasyāpyavabhāsate / tathā ghaṭānantaratā kiṃ tu sā niyamojjhitā ato yanniyamenaiva yasmādābhātyanantaram / tattasya kāraṇaṃ brūmaḥ sati rūpānvaye@dhike niyamaśca tathārūpabhāsanāmātrasārakaḥ / bījādaṅkura ityevaṃ bhāsanaṃ nahi sarvadā yogīcchānantarodbhūtatathābhūtāṅkuro yataḥ / iṣṭe tathāvidhākāre niyamo bhāsate yataḥ svapne ghaṭapaṭādīnāṃ hetutadvatsvabhāvatā / bhāsate niyamenaiva bādhāśūnyena tāvati tato yāvati yādrūpyānniyamo bādhavarjitaḥ / bhāti tāvati tādrūpyāddṛḍhahetuphalātmatā tathābhūte ca niyame hetutadvattvakāriṇi / vastutaścinmayasyaiva hetutā taddhi sarvagam ata eva ghaṭodbhūtau sāmagrī heturucyate / sāmagrī ca samagrāṇāṃ yadyekaṃ neṣyate vapuḥ

chunks.l2:
[tal-a09-v31] Not from cause-difference would difference be in effect — and that is incoherent, if it conforms to that invariable-concomitance-and-exclusion.

[tal-a09-v32] That its cause — if this, blunt logic is not dear to us; complete as staff thread wheel hand and the rest.

[tal-a09-v33] Distant and future thus as causes, we think — if there would be Meru, future or even some one.

[tal-a09-v34] The pot would certainly not be born, obstacle-removed — as the wheel in fixed place and time, causality.

[tal-a09-v35] Goes, like Karki-to-Meru stable-limit standing — thus of those causes, in joining and separating.

[tal-a09-v36] By necessity Shiva alone independent may attain agency — of the potter, which consciousness in wheel-stick-etc. joining.

[tal-a09-v37] Shiva indeed, for that of consciousness — what distinctness? But potter-like, from consciousness-limitation-manifestation.

[tal-a09-v38] Different-kalpa, if projected from staff-wheel-etc. middle — in each-one-making, Shiva, universe-one-bodied.

[tal-a09-v39] 'Doer!' — the person's doership-conceit too is the Lord's action; therefore indeed by such-appearance-ultimate-reality, of establishment.

[tal-a09-v40] Of cause-effect nature, in world and scripture, variegatedness — from Maya, of manifest and limited, thus, in the Raurava compendium.
chunks.sanskrit: [and]-hetubhedānna bhedaḥ syāt phale taccāsamañjasam / yadyasyānuvidhatte tāmanvayavyatirekitām tattasya hetu cetso@yaṃ kuṇṭhatarko na naḥ priyaḥ / samagrāśca yathā daṇḍasūtracakrakarādayaḥ dūrāśca bhāvinaścetthaṃ hetutveneti manmahe / yadi tatra bhavenmerurbhaviṣyanvāpi kaścana na jāyeta ghaṭo nūnaṃ tatpratyūhavyapohitaḥ / yathā ca cakraṃ niyate deśe kāle ca hetutām yāti karkisumervādyāstadvatsvasthāvadhi sthitāḥ / tathā ca teṣāṃ hetunāṃ saṃyojanaviyojane niyate śiva evaikaḥ svatantraḥ kartṛtāmiyāt / kumbhakārasya yā saṃvit cakradaṇḍādiyojane śiva eva hi sā yasmāt saṃvidaḥ kā viśiṣṭatā / kaumbhakārī tu saṃvittiravacchedāvabhāsanāt bhinnakalpā yadi kṣepyā daṇḍacakrādimadhyataḥ / tasmādekaikanirmāṇe śivo viśvaikavigrahaḥ karteti puṃsaḥ kartṛtvābhimāno@pi vibhoḥ kṛtiḥ / ata eva tathābhānaparamārthatayā sthiteḥ kāryakāraṇabhāvasya loke śāstre ca citratā / māyāto@vyaktakalayoriti rauravasaṃgrahe

chunks.l2:
[tal-a09-v41] In Sripurva, from kala-tattva the unmanifest, so said — from that indeed, from night-named Kali-become, unmarked.

[tal-a09-v42] Thus in our explained reasoning, reasoning is fruitless in the world — as from cow-dung worm, from resolve, from dream, from memory.

[tal-a09-v43] From yogi-will, substance-mantra-power-command, a scorpion — other indeed it is; if desired, from some own particularity.

[tal-a09-v44] That indeed everywhere equal — contemplation-unity is; but from that indeed, in own form and in sequence, of other kind, the state.

[tal-a09-v45] In scriptures joined, from wonder, from such-state nature — male attachment knowing art time illusion, in supreme knowledge, in order.

[tal-a09-v46] No necessity in Brahma's; above kala, necessity is heard on faith — above the three male-attachment-knowing, kala-necessity-container.

[tal-a09-v47] Time is called Maya; sequence, ray-scripture-going; purusa by necessity, and time endowed with raga-vidya-kala.

[tal-a09-v48] Thus this order enumerated in Matanga, in the supreme Lord — in cause-effect-natured tattva, thus established.

[tal-a09-v49] In the former scripture described, we state the causal hypothesis — Shiva, independent-seer-formed, full of five powers.

[tal-a09-v50] Freedom-illumined difference fivefold is divided — of consciousness bliss desire knowledge action, from clarity.
chunks.sanskrit: [and]-śrīpūrve tu kalātattvādavyaktamiti kathyate / tata eva niśākhyānātkalībhūtādaliṅgakam iti vyākhyāsmadukte@sminsati nyāye@tiniṣphalā / loke ca gomayātkīṭāt saṃkalpātsvapnataḥ smṛteḥ yogīcchāto dravyamantraprabhāvādeśca vṛścikaḥ / anya eva sa cet kāmaṃ kutaścitsvaviśeṣataḥ sa tu sarvatra tulyastatparāmarśaikyamasti tu / tata eva svarūpe@pi krame@pyanyādṛśī sthitiḥ śāstreṣu yujyate citrāt tathābhāvasvabhāvataḥ / puṃrāgavitkalākālamāyā jñānottare kramāt niyatirnāsti vairiñce kalordhve niyatiḥ śratā / puṃrāgavittrayādūrdhvaṃ kalāniyatisaṃpuṭam kālo māyeti kathitaḥ kramaḥ kiraṇaśāstragaḥ / pumānniyatyā kālaśca rāgavidyākalānvitaḥ ityeṣa krama uddiṣṭo mātaṅge pārameśvare / kāryakāraṇabhāvīye tattve itthaṃ vyavasthite śrīpūrvaśāstre kathitāṃ vacmaḥ kāraṇakalpanām / śivaḥ svatantradṛgrūpaḥ pañcaśaktisunirbharaḥ svātantryabhāsitabhidā pañcadhā pravibhajyate / cidānandeṣaṇājñānakriyāṇāṃ susphuṭatvataḥ

chunks.l2:
[tal-a09-v51] Named Shiva Shakti Sa Desha Avidya: five tattvas — in each one also, in this tattva, full of all powers.

[tal-a09-v52] By each-predominance-union that difference is determined — thus indeed by own-independence-fullness, the all-pervader.

[tal-a09-v53] By countless many, by forms shining, avoiding limitation — Shambhava ones, Shakti-born, mantra-great-lords, mantra-leaders.

[tal-a09-v54] Mantras thus pure would be these five groups in order — in each respective group shines whatever form, connected.

[tal-a09-v55] Therein reality thus said, like time-fire and earth — by that, what they call by narrative-similarity, mocked.

[tal-a09-v56] Guru-worship, without book-desired views — Brahma, Nivritti-lord, as separate tattva is not counted.

[tal-a09-v57] Sadashiva and the rest are counted separately — what principle? In the self supported by Brahma Vishnu Hara Ishana Susiva.

[tal-a09-v58] In six, cause-named, half-old this — whence? Thus from its root destroyed; counted, not indeed as cause.

[tal-a09-v59] As earth-lord king is no other reality — so those various lords separately, how another reality?

[tal-a09-v60] Thus this pentad is defined pure-path — there directly Shiva-will only, doer-appearing differentiator.
chunks.sanskrit: [and]-śivaśaktisadeśānavidyākhyaṃ tattvapañcakam / ekaikatrāpi tattve@smin sarvaśaktisunirbhare tattatprādhānyayogena sa sa bhedo nirūpyate / tathāhi svasvatantratvaparipūrṇatayā vibhuḥ niḥsaṃkhyairbahubhī rūpairbhātyavacchedavarjanāt / śāṃbhavāḥ śaktijā mantramaheśā mantranāyakāh mantrā iti viśuddhāḥ syuramī pañca gaṇāḥ kramāt / svasminsvasmin gaṇe bhāti yadyadrūpaṃ samanvayi tadeṣu tattvamityuktaṃ kālāgnyāderdharādivat / tena yatprāhurākhyānasādṛśyena viḍambitāḥ gurūpāsāṃ vinaivāttapustakābhīṣṭadṛṣṭayaḥ / brahmā nivṛttyadhipatiḥ pṛthaktattvaṃ na gaṇyate sadāśivādyāstu pṛthag gaṇyanta iti ko nayaḥ / brahmaviṣṇuhareśānasuśivānāśritātmani ṣaṭke kāraṇasaṃjñe@rdhajaratīyamiyaṃ kutaḥ / iti tanmūlato dhvastaṃ gaṇitaṃ nahi kāraṇam yathā pṛthivyadhipatirnṛpastattvāntaraṃ nahi / tathā tattatkaleśānaḥ pṛthak tattvāntaraṃ katham tadevaṃ pañcakamidaṃ śuddho@dhvā paribhāṣyate / tatra sākṣācchivecchaiva kartryābhāsitabhedikā

chunks.l2:
[tal-a09-v61] Lord-will-agitated enjoyment-craving consciousnesses, to distribute — Aghora-lord creates here white and other.

[tal-a09-v62] Of atoms longing named, actionless, desired — incomplete-thinking knowledge is impurity, abandoned with limitation.

[tal-a09-v63] Mere fitness only, this, for to-be-limited summary — by that impurity of this, no separate-reality-state exists, like attachment.

[tal-a09-v64] But unlimited-action-part-measure-limitation — that attachment in man, of intellect the nature: action-difference-variety.

[tal-a09-v65] Incomplete otherness, and this such-form appearance — of the independent one's Shiva-will: pot-form as pot.

[tal-a09-v66] Own-self-covering desire only, become thing, thus impurity — just as of the non-distinct, earth-and-rest become self-natured.

[tal-a09-v67] Thus also its, in scriptures distinct situated impurity — distinct, independent, not anyone, like cart and the rest.

[tal-a09-v68] That second, with impurity, Shiva-liberated-follower — what obstructing power of impurity exists? And that, unliberated-going.

[tal-a09-v69] Thus reason-abandoned doctrine, faith-only-imagined — the obstructing power of the inert by itself indeed does not proceed.

[tal-a09-v70] By itself in activity the universe would be thus — and what measure? Of impurity the obstructing, that power, if the Lord joins, that.
chunks.sanskrit: [and]-īśvarecchāvaśakṣubdhabhogalolikacidgaṇān / saṃvibhaktumaghoreśaḥ sṛjatīha sitetaram aṇūnāṃ lolikā nāma niṣkarmā yābhilāṣitā / apūrṇaṃmanyatājñānaṃ malaṃ sāvacchidojjhitā yogyatāmātramevaitadbhāvyavacchedasaṃgrahe / malastenāsya na pṛthaktattvabhāvo@sti rāgavat niravacchedakarmāṃśamātrāvacchedatastu sā / rāgaḥ puṃsi dhiyo dharmaḥ karmabhedavicitratā apūrṇamanyatā ceyaṃ tathārūpāvabhāsanam / svatantrasya śivasyecchā ghaṭarūpo yathā ghaṭaḥ svātmapracchādanecchaiva vastubhūtastathā malaḥ / yathaivāvyatiriktasya dharāderbhāvitātmatā tathaivāsyeti śāstreṣu vyatiriktaḥ sthito malaḥ / vyatiriktaḥ svatantrastu na ko@pi śakaṭādivat tatsadvitīyā sāśuddhiḥ śivamuktāṇugā na kim / malasya roddhrī kāpyasti śaktiḥ sa cāpyamuktagā iti nyāyojjhito vādaḥ śraddhāmātraikakalpitaḥ / roddhrī śaktirjaḍasyāsau svayaṃ naiva pravartate svayaṃ pravṛttau viśvaṃ syāttathā ceśanikā pramā / malasya roddhrīṃ tāṃ śaktimīśaścetsaṃyunakti tat

chunks.l2:
[tal-a09-v71] What-kind per atom-view: in the question, no answer-word; impurity-covering, and that not of the non-Aryan, distinctive.

[tal-a09-v72] Perception destroys this, jar-like, cloth-covering — of impurity-covered-form atoms, that is true-reality.

[tal-a09-v73] Shiva indeed, and that seeing would be his — impurity would be of the Lord's knowledge-action-essence followers and of the atom-group.

[tal-a09-v74] Its absence is impurity, established for form-destruction alone — from attribute in substratum, which difference, by inherence, and oneness.

[tal-a09-v75] Not as spoken by the become-that-ones, like Kanabhuj's disciple — neither by formless nor by formed can covering be.

[tal-a09-v76] Knowledge of visual rays, in such state, flows even — that indeed, and impurity embodied: what by knowledge is not known?

[tal-a09-v77] By all, then, why would not all attain omniscience? And who from darkness, of light covering, by opposers?

[tal-a09-v78] Of corporeal obstructed-light atoms, not formless such — nor dependent conscious self is impurity capable.

[tal-a09-v79] To cover, and what is to be covered — and Maya-covering example; as said by you thus: inert agent, not indeed by itself.

[tal-a09-v80] Of the independent Lord these powers are impelling indeed — therefore power-impelled lord knowing karma-fruit.
chunks.sanskrit: [and]-kīdṛśaṃ pratyaṇumiti praśne nāstyuttaraṃ vacaḥ / malaścāvaraṇaṃ tacca nāvāryasya viśeṣakam upalambhaṃ vihantyetadghaṭasyeva paṭāvṛtiḥ / malenāvṛtarūpāṇāmaṇūnāṃ yatsatattvakam śiva eva ca tatpaśyettasyaivāsau malo bhavet / vibhorjñānakriyāmātrasārasyāṇugaṇasya ca tadabhāvo malo rūpadhvaṃsāyaiva prakalpate / dharmāddharmiṇi yo bhedaḥ samavāyena caikatā na tadbhavadbhiruditaṃ kaṇabhojanaśiṣyavat / nāmūrtena na mūrtena prāvarītuṃ ca śakyate jñānaṃ cākṣuṣaraśmīnāṃ tathābhāve saratyapi / sa eva ca malo mūrtaḥ kiṃ jñānena na vedyate sarvageṇa tataḥ sarvaḥ sarvajñatvaṃ na kiṃ bhajet / yaśca dhvāntātprakāśasyāvṛtistatpratighātibhiḥ mūrtānāṃ pratighastejo@ṇūnāṃ nāmūrta īdṛśam / na ca cetanamātmānamasvatantro malaḥ kṣamaḥ āvarītuṃ na cācyaṃ ca madyāvṛtinidarśanam / uktaṃ bhavadbhirevetthaṃ jaḍaḥ kartā nahi svayam svatantrasyeśvarasyaitāḥ śaktayaḥ prerikāḥ kila / ataḥ karmavipākajñaprabhuśaktibaleritam

chunks.l2:
[tal-a09-v81] Wine produces intoxication, suffering-pleasure-delusion-fruit-natured — not if Lord-impelled, of man impurity would cover, since.

[tal-a09-v82] In the pure person, of the Lord impelling-nature is thus fitting — in equal pure state they would not impel; how?

[tal-a09-v83] Toward that Lord fit, which would be common nature of many — thereby only self-nature independence is impurity-expanded.

[tal-a09-v84] Determined, spread out, consciousness-filled elsewhere — enough, again: impurity-desire and ignorance-nescience, greed-practice.

[tal-a09-v85] Becoming-flaw flooding and exhaustion, withering, delusion — I-mine-self-affliction, Maya-power then covering.

[tal-a09-v86] Impurity-seed and animality, samsara-sprout-cause — by etymological names, there this is spoken.

[tal-a09-v87] In this being, being arises corrupted, by division-nature — flaw of being; like a couch, in this suffering-stream surely flows — what raft by that?

[tal-a09-v88] The rest are easily-accessible forms; words there infer meaning appropriately — cause of samsara is action, sprout of samsara is called.

[tal-a09-v89] Fourteenfold being-diversity is action-born, because — therefore indeed in Samkhya Yoga Pancaratra and teachings.

[tal-a09-v90] 'I-mine' thus complete abandonment is taught for actionlessness — actionless indeed, when established in root-impurity even in ignorance.
chunks.sanskrit: [and]-madyaṃ sūte madaṃ duḥkhasukhamohaphalātmakam / na ceśapreritaḥ puṃso mala āvṛṇuyādyataḥ nirmale puṃsi neśasya prerakatvaṃ tathocitam / tulye nirmalabhāve ca prerayeyurna te katham tamīśaṃ prati yuktaṃ yad bhūyasāṃ syātsadharmatā / tena svarūpasvātantryamātraṃ malavijṛmbhitam nirṇītaṃ vitataṃ caitanmayānyatretyalaṃ punaḥ / malo@bhilāṣaścājñānamavidyā lolikāprathā bhavadoṣo@nuplavaśca glāniḥ śoṣo vimūḍhatā / ahaṃmamātmatātaṅko māyāśaktirathāvṛtiḥ doṣabījaṃ paśutvaṃ ca saṃsārāṅkurakāraṇam / ityādyanvarthasaṃjñābhistatra tatraiṣa bhaṇyate asmin sati bhavati bhavo duṣṭo bhedātmaneti bhavadoṣaḥ / mañcavadasmin duḥkhasroto@ṇūn vahati yatplavastena śeṣāstu sugamarūpāḥ śabdāstatrārthamūhayeducitam / saṃsārakāraṇaṃ karma saṃsārāṅkura ucyate caturdaśavidhaṃ bhūtavaiciatryaṃ karmajaṃ yataḥ / ata eva sāṃkhyayogapāñcarātrādiśāsane ahaṃmameti saṃtyāgo naiṣkarmyāyopadiśyate / niṣkarmā hi sthite mūlamale@pyajñānanāmani

chunks.l2:
[tal-a09-v100] That well-known action-hood is not without contraction in the self; impurity regards varied different fruit as enjoyable.

[tal-a09-v91] From variety-cause-absence, neither upward moves nor even downward — only by limitation, not touching Shiva-nondifference.

[tal-a09-v92] Consciousness-alone is called, established in pure-consciousness-alone — he again from Shambhava-will, contemplating Shiva-nondifference.

[tal-a09-v93] Gradually mantra-lord-that-guide-formed, he goes to Shiva-selfhood — indeed whose is this cause? If karma-impurity, how?

[tal-a09-v94] He even of vijnanakala does not produce karma-continuity — not so; he indeed, impurity in jnanakala would destroy — how?

[tal-a09-v95] Cause would be destruction-sameness, from freedom alone would arise — in the called destroying-destroyed-destroyed, in three, then.

[tal-a09-v96] Within ten states, in created state-intervals, from own-sequence abiding — vijnana-akala-mantresa-tadisa-etc. conception.

[tal-a09-v97] In the fourth state, called sleep, manifold difference will be explained; therefore own power becomes totally oriented toward destruction.

[tal-a09-v98] Let impurity not be called the cause of action; action is not from impurity, since action is activity-natured.

[tal-a09-v99] Activity comes from the form of agency and freedom, not again from impurity; action-hood is the varied fruit-giving of this action.
chunks.sanskrit: [and]-vaicitryakāraṇābhāvānnordhva sarati nāpyadhaḥ / kevalaṃ pārimityena śivābhedamasaṃspṛśan vijñānakevalī proktaḥ śuddhacinmātrasaṃsthitaḥ / sa punaḥ śāṃbhavecchātaḥ śivābhedaṃ parāmṛśan kramānmantreśatannetṛrūpo yāti śivātmatām / nanu kāraṇametasya karmaṇaścenmalaḥ katham sa vijñānākalasyāpi na sūte karmasaṃtatim / maivaṃ sa hi malo jñānākale didhvaṃsiṣuḥ katham hetuḥ syāddhvaṃsamānatvaṃ svātantryādeva codbhavet / didhvaṃsiṣudhvaṃsamānadhvastākhyāsu tisṛṣvatha daśāsvantaḥ kṛtāvasthāntarāsu svakramasthiteḥ / vijñānākalamantreśatadīśāditvakalpanā tataśca supte turye ca vakṣyate bahubhedatā / ataḥ pradhvaṃsanaunmukhyakhilībhūtasvaśaktikaḥ karmaṇo hetutāmetu malaḥ kathamivocyatām / kiṃ ca karmāpi na malādyataḥ karma kriyātmakam kriyā ca kartṛtārūpāt svātantryānna punarmalāt / yā tvasya karmaṇaścitraphaladatvena karmatā prasiddhā sā na saṃkocaṃ vinātmani malaśca saḥ / vicitraṃ hi phalaṃ bhinnaṃ bhogyatvenābhimanyate

chunks.l2:
[tal-a09-v101] In the enjoyer-self, this difference-form arrangement exists; thus it resorts to cooperation in the production of its own work.

[tal-a09-v102] Impurity is the cause as power-manifesting of action; but if action exists, how can impurity also exist?

[tal-a09-v103] Limited knowledge has contraction; such contraction indeed exists; even destroyed contraction becomes firm by meditation.

[tal-a09-v104] Thinking 'I am not the doer,' one abandons action impression; the firm disposition in the self says this action will fruit.

[tal-a09-v105] That impression is for fruit here, not for causing remembering; even in undestroyed contraction, meditation on 'I am not the doer' acts.

[tal-a09-v106] Fruit does not arise for the intoxicated or deluded, nor when penance is done; austerity performed by me today would clearly be for him.

[tal-a09-v107] Action of an intentional agent does not fruit from intention; but intention-named action in the mental sphere is impression.

[tal-a09-v108] Producing fruit-stained action becomes fit for fruit attainment; whoever even there with firmness abandons fruit impression.

[tal-a09-v109] He enjoys a special fruit made by abandoning that fruit; by this method one abandons all action-continuity.

[tal-a09-v110] With non-ego union one should abandon; even the limited one with contraction should do so; but some wrong action is own and intentional.
chunks.sanskrit: [and]-bhoktaryātmani teneyaṃ bhedarūpā vyavasthitiḥ / iti svakāryaprasave sahakāritvamāśrayan sāmarthyavyañjakatvena karmaṇaḥ kāraṇaṃ malaḥ / nanvevaṃ karmasadbhāvānmalasyāpi sthiteḥ katham vijñānākalatā tasya saṃkoco hyasti tādṛśaḥ / maivamadhvastasaṃkoco@pyasau bhāvanayā dṛḍham nāhaṃ karteti manvānaḥ karmasaṃskāramujjhati / phaliṣyatīdaṃ karmeti yā dṛḍhā vṛttirātmani sa saṃskāraḥ phalāyeha na tu smaraṇakāraṇam / apradhvaste@pi saṃkoce nāhaṃ karteti bhāvanāt na phalaṃ kṣīvamūḍhādeḥ prāyaścitte@tha vā kṛte / yanmayādya tapastaptaṃ tadasmai syāditi sphuṭam abhisaṃdhimataḥ karma na phaledabhisandhitaḥ / tathābhisaṃdhānākhyāṃ tu mānase karma saṃskriyām phaloparaktāṃ vidadhatkalpate phalasampade / yastu tatrāpi dārḍhyena phalasaṃskāramujjhati sa tatphalatyāgakṛtaṃ viśiṣṭaṃ phalamaśnute / anayā paripāṭyā yaḥ samastāṃ karmasaṃtatim anahaṃyutayā projjhet sasaṃkoco@pi so@kalaḥ / nanvitthaṃ duṣkṛtaṃ kiṃcidātmīyamabhisaṃdhitaḥ

chunks.l2:
[tal-a09-v111] Real speech would not be known to another by you; if the enjoyer's intention were as in oneself, it would differ.

[tal-a09-v112] That wrong action would necessarily be of another too; in knowing another's intention, one's own intention becomes firm.

[tal-a09-v113] In absence of intention there is no fruit-connection; the convention 'wrong action is mine' is for fruitlessness.

[tal-a09-v114] In cutting another's intention, not intended by self, fruit would not be for both due to destruction-cause arrangement.

[tal-a09-v115] In pleasure-cause and pleasure of this, from common intention even from undifferentiated, just enjoyment of virtue-etc fruit.

[tal-a09-v116] Suffering or suffering-cause would be thus mine; but common intention would not be of that unrighteousness, nor scripture.

[tal-a09-v117] We speak the topic of the described limited knower: with non-ego union all action impressions are dissolved.

[tal-a09-v118] Therefore for this one action does not exist; impurity may do cooperation for anyone, and by that this one attains destruction-nature.

[tal-a09-v119] With destroyed impurity, controlled by inner Shiva possession, even ego-state goes, not action-dependent condition.

[tal-a09-v120] Said in holy previous scripture by the supreme lord: they desire impurity as ignorance, cause of the world sprout.
chunks.sanskrit: [and]-parasmai syānna vijñātaṃ bhavatā tāttvikaṃ vacaḥ / tasya bhoktustathā cetsyādabhisaṃdhiryathātmani tadavaśyaṃ parasyāpi satastadduṣkṛtaṃ bhavet / parābhisaṃdhisaṃvittau svābhisaṃdhirdṛḍhībhavet abhisaṃdhānavirahe tvasya no phalayogitā / na me duṣkṛtamityeṣā rūḍhistasyāphalāya sā parābhisandhivicchede svātmanānabhisaṃhitau / dvayorapi phalaṃ na syānnāśahetuvyavasthiteḥ sukhahetau sukhe cāsya sāmānyādabhisaṃdhitaḥ / nirviśeṣādapi nyāyyā dharmādiphalabhoktṛtā duḥkhaṃ me duḥkhaheturvā stādityeṣa punarna tu / sāmānyo@pyabhisaṃdhiḥ syāttadadharmasya nāgamaḥ prakṛtaṃ brūmahe jñānākalasyoktacarasya yat / anahaṃyutayā sarvā vilīnāḥ karmasaṃskriyāḥ tasmādasya na karmāsti kasyāpi sahakāritām / malaḥ karotu tenāyaṃ dhvaṃsamānatvamaśnute apadhvastamalastvantaḥśivāveśavaśīkṛtaḥ / ahaṃbhāvaparo@pyeti na karmādhīnavṛttitām uktaṃ śrīpūrvaśāstre ca tadetatparameśinā / malamajñānamicchanti saṃsārāṅkurakāraṇam

chunks.l2:
[tal-a09-v121] Action, of the nature of merit and demerit and marked by pleasure, pain, and the rest, is to be recognized by its own effect, from its being a cause.

[tal-a09-v122] A cause never exists at any time without its own effect; this fitness is causality itself, conditioned by the immediacy of the fruit.

[tal-a09-v123] But the causality of the earlier one, and what is that, is observed through pleasure, pain, and the rest, where a cause is seen in common.

[tal-a09-v124] By various other causes, something besides: here action is seen, born in one's own limb as grace, roughness, and the like, from one's own action.

[tal-a09-v125] Seen thus, action is posited as the cause dwelling in another body; here too, in other bodies, the fruit of action clearly appears, because.

[tal-a09-v126] Farming done in spring is enjoyed in autumn, and another body comes of it; as for one investigator, the origin is from here and there.

[tal-a09-v127] Its fruit is manifold, the action that is ancient; even a drunk king, if he were to command a cook in the morning just so.

[tal-a09-v128] Without the intention 'feed him' he obtains that fruit; thus even karma won in another birth ripens by present intention.

[tal-a09-v129] Without doing it again he enjoys the fruit, the cause there being the unshakability of the earlier [intention]; therefore action done by deed or by austerity too.

[tal-a09-v130] Or it would be restrained by knowledge, though bent on the ripening of the fruit; but the action begun in this body, that karma, how then?
chunks.sanskrit: [and]-dharmādharmātmakaṃ karma sukhaduḥkhādilakṣaṇam / lakṣayetsukhaduḥkhādi svaṃ kārya hetubhāvataḥ nahi hetuḥ kadāpyāste vinā kārya nijaṃ kvacit / hetutā yogyataivāsau phalānantaryabhāvitā pūrvakasya tu hetutvaṃ pāramparyeṇa kiṃ ca tat / lakṣyate sukhaduḥkhādyaiḥ samāne dṛṣṭakāraṇe citrairhetvantaraṃ kiṃcittacca karmeha darśanāt / svāṅge prasādaraukṣyādi jāyamānaṃ svakarmaṇā dṛṣṭamityanyadehasthaṃ kāraṇaṃ karma kalpyāte / ihāpyanyānyadehasthe sphuṭaṃ karmaphale yataḥ kṛṣikarma madhau bhogaḥ śaradyanyā ca sā tanuḥ / anusaṃdhāturekasya saṃbhavastu yatastataḥ tasyaiva tatphalaṃ citraṃ karma yasya purātanam / kṣīvo@pi rājā sūdaṃ cedādiśetprātarīdṛśam bhojayetyanusaṃdhānādvinā prāpnoti tatphalam / itthaṃ janmāntaropāttakarmāpyadyānusaṃdhinā vinā bhuṅkte phalaṃ hetustatra prācyā hyakampatā / ata eva kṛtaṃ karma karmaṇā tapasāpi vā jñānena vā nirudhyeta phalapākeṣvanunmukham / ārabdhakāryaṃ dehe@smin yatpunaḥ karma tatkatham

chunks.l2:
[tal-a09-v131] The last ten cannot be cut off; to restrain them is not possible, in that same body, whatever else there is, today's or ancient.

[tal-a09-v132] Karma is forced to be made a eunuch by that knowledge, initiation, and the like; for the firmness of the impression is indeed what gives the fruit its firmness.

[tal-a09-v133] When karma is destroyed, then even unmade action remains under delusion's dependence.

[tal-a09-v134] Even so, at knowledge-time all of that is burned, as the lord, giver and taker, all-seeing, has said.

[tal-a09-v135] In a moment all is burned: body-residing unmade and made action, through taking identity with the body.

[tal-a09-v136] By free will consciousness, there-standing karma is burned through abandoning body-unity desire and resting in world-self state.

[tal-a09-v137] In untimely ripening, the pervading undivided impression is indeed contraction, and he too is body-unity-made.

[tal-a09-v138] This karma impurity is said to be such that dissolution powers lie within the cave-depth like sleeping creepers.

[tal-a09-v139] Then awakened impressions, as fitting share holders, flow again and again from brahma to the immovable end.

[tal-a09-v140] Those again, for loss of karma impressions, with begun meditations, not reaching meditation completion, go to dissolution.
chunks.sanskrit: [and]-ucchidyatāmantyadaśaṃ niroddhuṃ nahi śakyate / tatraiva dehe yattvanyadadyagaṃ vā purātanam karma tajjñānadīkṣādyaiḥ śaṇḍhīkartuṃ prasahyate / tathā saṃskāradārḍhya hi phalāya dṛḍhatā punaḥ yadā yadā vinaśyeta karmadhvastaṃ tadā tadā / ato mohaparādhīno yadyapyakṛta kiṃcana tathāpi jñānakāle tatsarvameva pradahyate / uktaṃ ca śrīpare@hānādānaḥ sarvadṛgulvaṇaḥ muhūrtānnirdahetsarva dehasthamakṛtaṃ kṛtam / dehasthamiti dehena saha tādātmyamāśritā svācchandyātsaṃvidevoktā tatrasthaṃ karma dahyate / dehaikyavāsanātyāgāt sa ca viśvātmatāsthiteḥ akālakalite vyāpinyabhinne yā hi saṃskriyā / saṃkoca eva sānena so@pi dehaikatāmayaḥ etatkārmamalaṃ proktaṃ yena sākaṃ layākalāḥ / syurguhāgahanāntaḥsthāḥ suptā iva sarīsṛpāḥ tataḥ prabuddhasaṃskārāste yathocitabhāginaḥ / brahmādisthāvarānte@smin saṃsranti punaḥ punaḥ ye punaḥ karmasaṃskārahānyai prārabdhabhāvanāḥ / bhāvanāpariniṣpattimaprāpya pralayaṃ gatāḥ

chunks.l2:
[tal-a09-v141] They attain great mantra-hood through excellence of inner meditation ripeness, and varied results from karma.

[tal-a09-v142] Of this karma impurity going along the maya-end path, the chief cause is said to be the ignorance-atom impurity.

[tal-a09-v143] The agitation of this lolika-named thing clearly stands through cooperation and standing fitness depending on the lord's will.

[tal-a09-v144] Without consciousness, inert support is not capable anywhere, because atoms are named and the great lord alone is light-self.

[tal-a09-v145] The individual shines as both consciousness and non-consciousness; as field-knower and animal he is pervasive, without qualities, and actionless.

[tal-a09-v146] The eternal, formless desirer of yoga is declared; ignorance comes from non-consciousness, and difference arises between enjoyer and enjoyed.

[tal-a09-v147] That impurity of those atoms awakens strongly by the lord's will; thus it is said in the scripture named Sripurva.

[tal-a09-v148] By the lord's will, desire for enjoyment arises; the first mantra great lord helps that enjoyment desire.

[tal-a09-v149] Having agitated maya, he creates variegated samsara; maya is named the god's non-separate power.

[tal-a09-v150] Thus independence of difference-appearance: he is made by her as the first difference-appearance, which has not reached separation.
chunks.sanskrit: [and]-mahāntaṃ te tathāntaḥsthabhāvanāpākasauṣṭhavāt / mantratvaṃ pratipadyante citrāccitraṃ ca karmataḥ asya kārmamalasyeyanmāyāntādhvavisāriṇaḥ / pradhānaṃ kāraṇaṃ proktamajñānātmāṇavo malaḥ kṣobho@sya lolikākhyasya sahakāritayā sphuṭam / tiṣṭhāsāyogyataunmukhyamīśvarecchāvaśācca tat na jaḍaścidadhiṣṭhānaṃ vinā kvāpi kṣamo yataḥ / aṇavo nāma naivānyatprakāśātmā maheśvaraḥ cidacidrūpatābhāsī pudgalaḥ kṣetravitpaśuḥ / cidrūpatvācca sa vyāpī nirguṇo niṣkriyastataḥ yogopāyepsako nityo mūrtivandhyaḥ prabhāṣyate / acittvādajñatā bhedo bhogyādbhoktrantarādatha teṣāmaṇūnāṃ sa mala īśvarecchāvaśādbhṛśam / prabudhyate tathā coktaṃ śāstre śrīpūrvanāmani īśvarecchāvaśādasya bhogecchā saṃprajāyate / bhogecchorupakārārthamādyo mantramaheśvaraḥ māyāṃ vikṣobhya saṃsāraṃ nirmimīte vicitrakam / māyā ca nāma devasya śaktiravyatirekiṇī bhedāvabhāsasvātantryaṃ tathāhi sa tayā kṛtaḥ / ādyo bhedāvabhāso yo vibhāgamanupeyivān

chunks.l2:
[tal-a09-v151] She is the appearance containing infinite beings; supreme night is inert because of difference-form, and her effect is inert for that reason.

[tal-a09-v152] Pervading because it causes the universe, subtle because of single effect-conception, and eternal one because of inseparability of shiva and power, it is the root cause.

[tal-a09-v153] All effect is unconscious and many-self, as a pot is primary; therefore effect is not self, but conscious.

[tal-a09-v154] Therefore in the path it was declared before that maya is twofold; god's maya-power approaches as differentiating.

[tal-a09-v155] Thus another, kala and so on, expands reality-nature by restricted power, having limited agency.

[tal-a09-v156] The lord's power, throwing the man below, is called kala; thus vidya and others, ending in earth, are ultimately so.

[tal-a09-v157] Siva-Sakti-made indeed, per stated reasoning — yet that distinct appearance of kala and the rest is by Isvara-will.

[tal-a09-v158] Then in inertness, in effected-ness, in separate-tattva-state certainly — the material cause is remembered as Maya; sometimes that effect only.

[tal-a09-v159] Thus-appearing variegated, form mutually excluded — what shines in imagination exists, like pot, outside.

[tal-a09-v160] Sky-flower and the rest — existence we assert, therefore no invalidity; the sky-flower, time-direction-mother-dependent, by the word 'does not exist.'
chunks.sanskrit: [and]-garbhīkṛtānantabhāvivibhāsā sā parā niśā / sā jaḍā bhedarūpatvāt kāryaṃ cāsyā jaḍaṃ yataḥ vyāpinī viśvahetutvāt sūkṣmā kāryaikakalpanāt / śivaśaktyavinābhāvānnityaikā mūlakāraṇam acetanamanekātma sarva kārya yathā ghaṭaḥ / pradhānaṃ ca tathā tasmāt kārya nātmā tu cetanaḥ ata evādhvani proktā pūrvaṃ māyā dvidhā sthitā / yathā ca māyā devasya śaktirabhyeti bhedinam tattvabhāvaṃ tathānyo@pi kalādistattvavistaraḥ / niruddhaśakteryā kiṃcitkartṛtodvalanātmikā nāthasya śaktiḥ sādhastātpuṃsaḥ kṣeptrī kalocyate / evaṃ vidyādayo@pyete dharāntāḥ paramārthataḥ śivaśaktimayā eva proktanyāyānusārataḥ / tathāpi yatpṛthagbhānaṃ kalāderīśvarecchayā tato jaḍatve kāryatve pṛthaktattvasthitau dhruvam / upādānaṃ smṛtā māyā kvacittatkāryameva ca tathāvabhāsacitraṃ ca rūpamanyonyavarjitam / yadbhāti kila saṃkalpe tadasti ghaṭavadvahiḥ khapuṣpādyastitāṃ brūmastato na vyabhicāritā / khapuṣpaṃ kāladiṅmātṛsāpekṣaṃ nāstiśabdataḥ

chunks.l2:
[tal-a09-v161] Like earth and the rest, thus absolute absence too be distinguished — what is to be imagined, thus of that the outer body is conscious.

[tal-a09-v162] Ending with Caitra Vatsa Ausiva — all that, such-bodied — whose body as his, of that kind the city outside.

[tal-a09-v163] Therefore up to Susiva the world-path is established — of selves, that city to be attained, like another place by being a place.

[tal-a09-v164] Self path-enjoyership then by effort is accomplished — that Maya, agitated, births the universe all around.

[tal-a09-v165] Like amla struck by a stick, fruits indeed although — nevertheless thus, from variegated prior-posterior manifestation.

[tal-a09-v166] Even in Maya-effect, in the tattva-flood, cause-effect mutual — though in other scriptures clearly seen in many ways.

[tal-a09-v167] Nevertheless by Malini-scripture view we declare — from kala to earth, which ends in Maya, they declare.

[tal-a09-v168] This is distinct for each self, by pleasure-pain distinction — in one world only, in the enjoyment-means aggregate.

[tal-a09-v169] Of pleasures equal manifestation — whence would experience-difference be? Not by karma-difference either, from that very impossibility.

[tal-a09-v170] Therefore the kala-beginning class is ever indeed distinct — it attains unity by Lord-will in dance song and playing.
chunks.sanskrit: [and]-dharādivat tathātyantābhāvo@pyevaṃ vivicyatām / yatsaṃkalpyaṃ tathā tasya bahirdeho@sti cetanaḥ caitravatsauśivāntaṃ tat sarva tādṛśadehavat / yasya deho yathā tasya tajjātīyaṃ puraṃ bahiḥ ataḥ suśivaparyantā siddhā bhuvanapaddhatiḥ / ātmanām tatpuraṃ prāpyaṃ deśatvādanyadeśavat ātmanāmadhvabhoktṛtvaṃ tato@yatnena siddhyati / sā māyā kṣobhamāpannā viśvaṃ sūte samantataḥ daṇḍāhatevāmalakī phalāni kila yadyapi / tathāpi tu tathā citrapaurvāparyāvabhāsanāt māyākārye@pi tattvaughe kāryakāraṇatā mithaḥ / sā yadyapyanyaśāstreṣu bahudhā dṛśyate sphuṭam tathāpi mālinīśāstradṛśā tāṃ saṃpracakṣmahe / kalādivasudhāntaṃ yanmāyāntaḥ saṃpracakṣate pratyātmabhinnamevaitat sukhaduḥkhādibhedataḥ / ekasyāmeva jagati bhogasādhanasaṃhatau sukhādīnāṃ samaṃ vyakterbhogabhedaḥ kuto bhavet / na cāsau karmabhedena tasyaivānupapattitaḥ tasmāt kalādiko vargo bhinna eva kadācana / aikyametīśvarecchāto nṛttagītādivādane

chunks.l2:
[tal-a09-v171] Of these kala-beginning tattvas, of all future ones, purity belongs to those purified by power-descent.

[tal-a09-v172] For kala indeed pure, such-like, produces karma-nature — limited even so, quickly, by which from this samsara one is freed.

[tal-a09-v173] Raga vidya kala yati prakrti aksa artha collection — thus pure, having proclaimed, the guru in honor-praise, the all-lord.

[tal-a09-v174] Thus this origin of kala and the rest is distinguished — from Maya-principle kala arose, marked by limited doership.

[tal-a09-v175] Maya indeed produces difference from consciousness-full, from Shiva, of the bound — imposes a deep-sleep-like state; from that only, perception-and-action-less.

[tal-a09-v176] For kala produces limited doership from self-embrace of the atom — of that too, atom with atom mutually; in collyrium she is born.

[tal-a09-v177] In immediate-liberation-initiation-born male-separation indeed, she being — clinging too and not producing — still own fruit somewhere.

[tal-a09-v178] Like swelling first and like subtle sprout — from seed-water-fire-earth-shell-husk union, the birth-maker.

[tal-a09-v179] Kala, Maya-atom-union-born — the unchanging makes material cause not the atom, but mutable Maya.

[tal-a09-v180] Impurity and covering, Maya the becoming's material cause — action may be co-cause indeed toward pleasure-pain origin.
chunks.sanskrit: [and]-eṣāṃ kalāditattvānāṃ sarveṣāmapi bhāvinām / śuddhatvamasti teṣāṃ ye śaktipātapavitritāḥ kalā hi śuddhā tattādṛk karmatvaṃ saṃprasūyate / mitamapyāśu yenāsmāt saṃsārādeṣa mucyate rāgavidyākālayatiprakṛtyakṣārthasaṃcayaḥ / itthaṃ śuddha iti procya gururmānastutau vibhuḥ evameṣā kalādīnāmutpattiḥ pravivicyate / māyātattvāt kalā jātā kiṃcitkartṛtvalakṣaṇā māyā hi cinmayādbhedaṃ śivādvidadhatī paśoḥ / suṣuptatāmivādhatte tata eva hyadṛkkriyaḥ kalā hi kiṃcitkartṛtvaṃ sūte svāliṅganādaṇoḥ / tasyāścāpyaṇunānyonyaṃ hyañjane sā prasūyate sadyonirvāṇadīkṣotthapuṃviśleṣe hi sā satī / śliṣyantyapi ca no sūte tathāpi svaphalaṃ kvacit ucchūnateva prathamā sūkṣmāṅkurakaleva ca / bījasyāmbvagnimṛtkambutuṣayogāt prasūtikṛt kalā māyāṇusaṃyogajāpyeṣā nirvikārakam / nāṇuṃ kuryādupādānaṃ kiṃtu māyāṃ vikāriṇīm malaścāvārako māyā bhāvopādānakāraṇam / karma syāt sahakāryeva sukhaduḥkhodbhavaṃ prati

chunks.l2:
[tal-a09-v181] Therefore concealed-consciousness-uplifting-action-doing, of Ananta-lord power only — by power impelled, inert.

[tal-a09-v182] Not even the Lord's power will strengthen his consciousness — that strengthened, that indeed would not reach any doership.

[tal-a09-v183] This kala is no principal instrument, as knowledge and the rest — in man as agent she is agent, by being instigator, because.

[tal-a09-v184] Thus when two imperceptible interiors occur for the two pumskala — of Maya-garbha-lord-power and the rest, interior knowledge interior.

[tal-a09-v185] Then Maya-purusha discrimination from all-karma destruction becomes — vijnanakala-state below Maya does not go; down goes the man.

[tal-a09-v186] In intellect-discrimination, when known, in pradhana-purusha interval — even so no karma-exhausted would be; in kala-covering that may arise.

[tal-a09-v187] Therefore by Samkhya view the established below pradhana would not transmigrate — in kala-purusha discrimination below Maya never goes.

[tal-a09-v188] Seeing the self separated from impurity, one would reach Shiva-hood — everywhere and lordly, power-descent here is co-cause.

[tal-a09-v189] Maya-garbha authorities, in the last of the two pure — this kala, by effect-difference, is other indeed inferred.

[tal-a09-v190] Otherwise the universe would be one — for action, thus other-denial; thus in Matanga-scripture and the rest, what is declared, that kala itself.
chunks.sanskrit: [and]-ataḥ saṃcchannacaitanyasamudbalanakāryakṛt / kalaivānantanāthasya śaktyā saṃpreritā jaḍā na ceśaśaktirevāsya caitanyaṃ balayiṣyati / tadupodbalitaṃ taddhi na kiṃcitkartṛtāṃ vrajet seyaṃ kalā na karaṇaṃ mukhyaṃ vidyādikaṃ yathā / puṃsi kartari sā kartrī prayojakatayā yataḥ alakṣyāntarayoritthaṃ yadā puṃskalayorbhavet / māyāgarbheśaśaktyāderantarajñānamāntaram tadā māyāpuṃvivekaḥ sarvakarmakṣayādbhavet / vijñānākalatā māyādhastānno yātyadhaḥ pumān dhīpuṃviveke vijñāte pradhānapuruṣāntare / api na kṣīṇakarmā syāt kalāyāṃ taddhi saṃbhavet ataḥ sāṃkhyadṛśā siddhaḥ pradhānādho na saṃsaret / kalāpuṃsorviveke tu māyādho naiva gacchati malādviviktamātmānaṃ paśyaṃstu śivatāṃ vrajet / sarvatra caiśvaraḥ śaktipāto@tra sahakāraṇam māyāgarbhādhikārīyo dvayorantye tu nirmalaḥ / seyaṃ kalā kāryabhedādanyaiva hyanumīyate anyathaikaṃ bhavedviśvaṃ kāryāyetyanyanihnavaḥ / iti mataṅgaśāstrādau yā proktā sā kalā svayam

chunks.l2:
[tal-a09-v191] Having excluded by some-form agency, thus broken — endowed with some-form, which agency, how then would it be?

[tal-a09-v192] Of the ignorant thus, then produces limited-knowing-natured knowledge — intellect he sees; that vidya, intellect-mirror-dwelling.

[tal-a09-v193] The own self distinguishes pleasure and related cognitions, delusion and the rest, and the karma-net standing in effect and cause.

[tal-a09-v194] But how can an intellect mixed with qualities, by discrimination, show pleasure, pain, or a delusion-natured object?

[tal-a09-v195] How does a transferring state remove knowability in the clear intellect, when another instrument acts in the person as agent?

[tal-a09-v196] Indeed a state shines from both person-light and bright mirror-like intellect; not so, it is its reflection.

[tal-a09-v197] For primary illumination is inert; person-light illuminates what is external, so what construction is made of intellect?

[tal-a09-v198] This is the ground of nondifference, and difference is examined here; therefore the state gone into intellect is within the range of the knowledge instrument.

[tal-a09-v199] The reflection of states is knowable, and intellect-construction does something from that; therefore certainly there is another thing.

[tal-a09-v200] The raga-principle is declared as that which colors there; it is not merely nonattachment, because attachment-operation is there too.
chunks.sanskrit: [and]-kiṃcidrūpatayākṣipya kartṛtvamiti bhaṅgitaḥ / kiṃcidrūpaviśiṣṭaṃ yat kartṛtvaṃ tatkathaṃ bhavet ajñasyeti tataḥ sūte kiṃcijjñatvātmikāṃ vidam / buddhiṃ paśyati sā vidyā buddhidarpaṇacāriṇaḥ sukhādīn pratyayān mohaprabhṛtīn kāryakāraṇe / karmajālaṃ ca tatrasthaṃ vivinakti nijātmanā buddhistu guṇasaṃkīrṇā vivekena kathaṃ sukham / duḥkhaṃ mohātmakaṃ vāpi viṣayaṃ darśayedapi svacchāyāṃ dhiyi saṃkrāmanbhāvaḥ saṃvedyatāṃ katham / tayā vinaiti sāpyanyatkaraṇaṃ puṃsi kartari nanu cobhayataḥ śubhrādarśadaśīyadhīgatāt / puṃsprakāśādbhāti bhāvaḥ maivaṃ tatpratibimbanam jaḍameva hi mukhyo@tha puṃsprakāśo@sya bhāsanam / bahiḥsthasyaiva tasyāstu buddheḥ kiṃkalpanā kṛtā abhedabhūmireṣā ca bhedaśceha vicāryate / tasmādbuddhigato bhāvo vidyākaraṇagocaraḥ bhāvānāṃ pratibimbaṃ ca vedyaṃ dhīkalpanā tataḥ / kiṃcittu kurute tasmānnūnamastyaparaṃ tu tat rāgatattvamiti proktaṃ yattatraivoparañjakam / na cāvairāgyamātraṃ tattatrāpyāsaktivṛttitaḥ

chunks.l2:
[tal-a09-v201] Even in a detached, satisfied one, subtle raga is established; time, praise, and so on measure agency from that.

[tal-a09-v202] Effect-limiting agency necessarily disturbs time; necessity bears connection in the distinct sphere of effects.

[tal-a09-v203] Knowledge, raga, necessity, and time are this fourfold; kala-effect fills the enjoyer-state with standing enjoyership.

[tal-a09-v204] Maya, kala, raga, vidya, time, and necessity are the six declared coverings; in that state the bound soul stands in consciousness.

[tal-a09-v205] Knowing indeed occurs in body-city and knowables; this is sixfold contraction, while the unknowable is the atom.

[tal-a09-v206] It is said in the Shiva-body treatise; this covering is again stated by another mode, concerning all-self-going purity.

[tal-a09-v207] Because it is burnable by Shiva's fire-ray nets, that covering is other-form by not-this priority; since it colors by own self, it is not other.

[tal-a09-v208] For the naturally impure atom and Isha-cave, a threefold covering is applied; smooth kala is like a second consciousness of the clear.

[tal-a09-v209] By this, the bound soul of the knower becomes capable of enjoyment; its knowledge arises from kala like a lamp within refuge.

[tal-a09-v210] It distinguishes pleasure-pain cognition for the bound soul; raga arises from the kala-principle like dye on pure cloth.
chunks.sanskrit: [and]-viraktāvapi tṛptasya sūkṣmarāgavyavasthiteḥ / kālastuṭyādibhiścaitat kartṛtvaṃ kalayatyataḥ kāryāvacchedi kartṛtvaṃ kālo@vaśyaṃ kaliṣyati / niyatiryojanāṃ dhatte viśiṣṭe kāryamaṇḍale vidyā rāgo@tha niyatiḥ kālaścaitaccatuṣṭayam / kalākāryaṃ bhoktṛbhāve tiṣṭhadbhoktṛtvapūritam māyā kalā rāgavidye kālo niyatireva ca / kañcukāni ṣaḍuktāni saṃvidastatsthitau paśuḥ dehapuryaṣṭakādyeṣu vedyeṣu kila vedanam / etatṣaṭkasasaṃkocaṃ yadavedyamasāvaṇuḥ uktaṃ śivatanuśāstre tadidaṃ bhaṅgyantareṇa punaḥ / āvaraṇaṃ sarvātmagamaśuddhiranyāpyananyarūpeva śivadahanakiraṇajālairdāhyatvāt sā yato@nyarūpaiva / anidaṃpūrvatayā yadrañjayati nijātmanā tato@nanyā sahajāśuddhimato@ṇorīśaguhābhyāṃ hi kañcukastrividhaḥ / tasya dvitīyacitiriva svacchasya niyujyate kalā ślakṣṇā anayā vidvasya paśorupabhogasamarthatā bhavati / vidyā cāsya kalātaḥ śaraṇāntardīpakaprabhevābhūt sukhaduḥkhasaṃvidaṃ yā vivinakti paśorvibhāgena / rāgaśca kalātattvācchucivastrakaṣāyavat samutpannaḥ

chunks.l2:
[tal-a09-v211] One does not desire to abandon it, because worldly pleasure-cognition-bliss is present; the ignorance-stained one is enabled by the force of the three-quality covering.

[tal-a09-v212] The helpless bound soul falls downward in the deep enjoyment-womb; by this impurity is described, while kala and so on are like husk around the atom's shell.

[tal-a09-v213] Thus in the kala-named principle, in a distinct part marked by some agency, agency is discussed as preceded by enjoyer.

[tal-a09-v214] As distinction, some part arises here as only-knowable, clear, and distinct; kala produces the primary.

[tal-a09-v215] For kala equally produces the enjoyable and the enjoyer, not separated by difference-intention, mutually.

[tal-a09-v216] Enjoyer-enjoyed nature would not be from separation, nor mutually in the dissolved state; maya too would not be anything.

[tal-a09-v217] Indeed from glorious Raurava onward, the raga-vidya-natured pair produces — kala indeed simultaneously from that manifest, thus the doctrine.

[tal-a09-v218] Said here: this order shines, true — thus indeed enough: being colored one knows all, and knowing all here one is colored.

[tal-a09-v219] Nevertheless reality-existence here by us determined — and in that no sequence at all; or if any, that too from inversion.

[tal-a09-v220] Therefore admit no disagreement about the scripture-stated rule — thus only the experienced, which from pleasure-pain-delusion.
chunks.sanskrit: [and]-tyaktuṃ vāñchati na yataḥ saṃsṛtisukhasaṃvidānandam / evamavidyāmalinaḥsamarthitastriguṇakañcukabalena gahanopabhogagarbhe paśuravaśamadhomukhaḥ patati / etena malaḥ kathitaḥ kambukavadaṇoḥ kalādikaṃ tuṣavat evaṃ kalākhyatattvasya kiṃcitkartṛtvalakṣaṇe / viśeṣabhāge kartṛtvaṃ carcitaṃ bhoktṛpūrvakam viśeṣaṇatayā yo@tra kiñcidbhāgastadotthitam / vedyamātraṃ sphuṭaṃ bhinnaṃ pradhānaṃ sūyate kalā samameva hi bhogyaṃ ca bhoktāraṃ ca prasūyate / kalā bhedābhisaṃdhānādaviyuktaṃ parasparam bhoktṛbhogyātmatā na syādviyogācca parasparam / vilīnāyāṃ ca tasyāṃ syānmāyāsyāpi na kiṃcana nanu śrīmadrauravādau rāgavidyātmakaṃ dvayam / sūte kalā hi yugapattato@vyaktamiti sthitiḥ uktamatra vibhātyeṣa kramaḥ satyaṃ tathā hyalam / rajyamāno veda sarva vidaṃścāpyatra rajyate tathāpi vastusatteyamihāsmābhirnirūpitā / tasyāṃ ca na kramaḥ ko@pi syādvā so@pi viparyayāt tasmādvipratipattiṃ no kuryācchāstrodite vidhau / evaṃ saṃvedyamātraṃ yat sukhaduḥkhavimohataḥ

chunks.l2:
[tal-a09-v221] What will become from that is said equal-natured with that from the start — pleasure is sattva from luminosity; light is called delight.

[tal-a09-v222] Suffering is rajas from activity-nature — activity indeed crosses that; delusion is darkness, a covering, from light-absence-yoga.

[tal-a09-v223] Those agitated gunas produce effects — of the unagitated no heterogeneous effect would have been before.

[tal-a09-v224] Thus it is said in this treatise: the gunas know another tattva — worlds separately here shown by guna-difference.

[tal-a09-v225] Lord-will-power-agitated fickle man, for enjoyership — the independent Lord greatly agitates nature.

[tal-a09-v226] By that, what Samkhya says about the freed atom — why would she not produce, from purusha's modifiability — that is no obstacle here.

[tal-a09-v227] From gunas the buddhi-principle, stainless all around — from that purusha-light, knowable here, attains reflection.

[tal-a09-v228] Object-reflection in that sense-made outside — not by that gateway; in projection appearance and the rest, such.

[tal-a09-v229] Function-cognition may be of intellect — and also support, fixed; of self-awareness-light that cognition — inert too, enough.

[tal-a09-v230] Buddhi-ego-made, such-like, of reflected-male-made — in light, in stained knowable, that I-thought-selfhood.
chunks.sanskrit: [and]-bhotsyate yattataḥ proktaṃ tatsāmyātmakamāditaḥ / sukhaṃ sattvaṃ prakāśatvāt prakāśo hlāda ucyate duḥkhaṃ rajaḥ kriyātmatvād kriyā hi tadatatkramaḥ / mohastamo varaṇakaḥ prakāśābhāvayogataḥ ta ete kṣobhamāpannā guṇāḥ kārya pratanvate / akṣubdhasya vijātīyaṃ na syāt kāryamadaḥ purā uktameveti śāstre@smin guṇāṃstattvāntaraṃ viduḥ / bhuvanaṃ pṛthagevātra darśitaṃ guṇabhedataḥ īśvarecchāvaśakṣubdhalolikaṃ puruṣaṃ prati / bhoktṛtvāya svatantreśaḥ prakṛtiṃ kṣobhayed bhṛśam tena yaccodyate sāṃkhyaṃ muktāṇuṃ prati kiṃ na sā / sūte puṃso vikāritvāditi tannātra bādhakam guṇebhyo buddhitattvaṃ tat sarvato nirmalaṃ tataḥ / puṃsprakāśaḥ sa vedyo@tra pratibimbatvamārchati viṣayapratibimbaṃ ca tasyāmakṣakṛtaṃ bahiḥ / ataddvāraṃ samutprekṣāpratibhādiṣu tādṛśī vṛttirbodho bhavedbuddheḥ sā cāpyālambanaṃ dhruvam / ātmasaṃvitprakāśasya bodho@sau tajjaḍo@pyalam buddherahaṃkṛt tādṛkṣe pratibimbitapuṃskṛteḥ / prakāśe vedyakaluṣe yadahaṃmananātmatā

chunks.l2:
[tal-a09-v231] By that agitation-formed fivefold wind impelled — for life; otherwise death again.

[tal-a09-v232] Therefore indeed from pure-self-freedom-I-nature, this from uncreated — but the other, so said, from the word krti.

[tal-a09-v233] Thus this ego's instrument-aggregate is determined — threefold its nature-aggregate: sattvic rajasic tamasic.

[tal-a09-v234] Clearly from sattva-predominant ego touching enjoyer-portion — mind buddhi senses sixfold born; but difference is stated.

[tal-a09-v235] Mind, which is all-object, thereby here intended to be stated — all-subtle-element agency is ego's qualifier.

[tal-a09-v236] Buddhi ego mind, they say, in awakening-quest is instrument — by outer gods not, nor even by inward-facing made.

[tal-a09-v237] And breath is no inner instrument, from inertness — of impelling nature; as cause of effort-desire-cognition portions — certain.

[tal-a09-v238] Determination and egoism, imagination and the rest, are not one-formed action — therefore three-ness, fitting in inner action, clearly.

[tal-a09-v239] And buddhi is not insentient — instrumentality is mind's, as with pradhana; the like-pradhana-insentient-buddhi doctrine is rejected.

[tal-a09-v240] Distinguished by sound-tanmatra-causality, that ego-principle — in ear as sense-organ, up to nose where smell-ness is indicated.
chunks.sanskrit: [and]-tayā pañcavidhaścaiṣa vāyuḥ saṃrambharūpayā / prerito jīvanāya syādanyathā maraṇaṃ punaḥ ata eva viśuddhātmasvātantryāhaṃsvabhāvataḥ / akṛtrimādidaṃ tvanyadityuktaṃ kṛtiśabdataḥ ityayaṃ karaṇaskandho@haṃkārasya nirūpitaḥ / tridhāsya prakṛtiskandhaḥ sāttvarājasatāmasaḥ sattvapradhānāhaṃkārādbhoktraṃśasparśinaḥ sphuṭam / manobuddhyakṣaṣaṭkaṃ tu jātaṃ bhedastu kathyate mano yatsarvaviṣayaṃ tenātra pravivakṣitam / sarvatanmātrakartṛtvaṃ viśeṣaṇamahaṃkṛteḥ buddhyahaṃkṛnmanaḥ prāhurbodhasaṃrabhaṇaiṣaṇe / karaṇaṃ bāhyadevairyannaivāpyantarmukhaiḥ kṛtam prāṇaśca nāntaḥkaraṇaṃ jaḍatvāt preraṇātmanaḥ / prayatnecchāvibodhāṃśahetutvāditi niścitam avasāyo@bhimānaśca kalpanā ceti na kriyā / ekarūpā tatastritvaṃ yuktamantaḥkṛtau sphuṭam na ca buddhirasaṃvedyā karaṇatvānmano yathā / pradhānavadasaṃvedyabuddhivādastadujjhitaḥ śabdatanmātrahetutvaviśiṣṭā yā tvahaṃkṛtiḥ / sā śrotre karaṇaṃ yāvadghrāṇe gandhatvabhoditā

chunks.l2:
[tal-a09-v241] Because of material nature, awareness in objects is limited to ordinary acts like hearing and seeing.

[tal-a09-v242] Ego-nature is clearly established, so instrumentality is fitting through union with agency.

[tal-a09-v243] An instrument differs from the agent because it is driven, and another instrument would lead to instability.

[tal-a09-v244] Therefore, by freedom, the agent divides his own body and makes his own part into an instrument.

[tal-a09-v245] Through meditation on that part, he makes something completely distinct, like an axe.

[tal-a09-v246] Therefore, before cognition, the common instrument of impure knowledge is called power in action.

[tal-a09-v247] But in Matanga and others, power's agenthood is declared, and knowledge deserves instrumentality.

[tal-a09-v248] It is said that agenthood is the cause of instrumentality, because without it other instruments have no stability.

[tal-a09-v249] From the common instrument group, knowledge is made separate, because without it other instruments lack their own stability.

[tal-a09-v250] Without power there is no agenthood or knowership, so power and knowledge are known as the person's chief instruments.
chunks.sanskrit: [and]-bhautikatvamato@pyastu niyamādviṣayeṣvalam / ahaṃ śṛṇomi paśyāmi jighrāmītyādisaṃvidi ahaṃtānugamādāhaṃkārikatvaṃ sphuṭaṃ sthitam / karaṇatvamato yuktaṃ kartraśaspṛktvayogataḥ karturvibhinnaṃ karaṇaṃ preryatvāt karaṇaṃ kutaḥ / karaṇāntaravāñchāyāṃ bhavettatrānavasthitiḥ tasmāt svātantryayogena kartā svaṃ bhedayan vapuḥ / karmāśasparśinaṃ svāṃśaṃ karaṇīkurute svayam karaṇīkṛtatatsvāṃśatanmayībhāvanāvaśāt / karaṇīkurute@tyantavyatiriktaṃ kuṭhāravat tenāśuddhaiva vidyāsya sāmānyaṃ karaṇaṃ purā / jñaptau kṛtau tu sāmānyaṃ kalā karaṇamucyate nanu śrīmanmataṅgādau kalāyāḥ kartṛtoditā / tasyāṃ satyāṃ hi vidyādyāḥ karaṇatvārhatājuṣaḥ ucyate kartṛtaivoktā karaṇatve prayojikā / tayā vinā tu nānyeṣāṃ karaṇānāṃ sthitiryataḥ ato@sāmānyakaraṇavargāt tatra pṛthak kṛtā / vidyāṃ vinā hi nānyeṣāṃ karaṇānāṃ nijā sthitiḥ kalāṃ vinā na tasyāśca kartṛtve jñātṛtā yataḥ / kalāvidye tataḥ puṃso mukhyaṃ tatkaraṇaṃ viduḥ

chunks.l2:
[tal-a09-v251] Therefore, even when mind and action senses are lacking, form and motion do not shine for the blind or lame.

[tal-a09-v252] But by common instrument power, even the blind attains perception of common form.

[tal-a09-v253] Then from ego, beyond the subtle elements, action organs such as speech and hands are born.

[tal-a09-v254] Actions like speaking and taking are ego actions; an action organ is that capable of action.

[tal-a09-v255] Even when the hand is cut, the action-organ nature remains; its chief seat is the five-fingered hand.

[tal-a09-v256] Even when taking by mouth, the established instrument is the hand; without it, action would not arise.

[tal-a09-v257] Even with mind senses, seeing depends on an instrument because of action nature.

[tal-a09-v258] Others do not accept going as an instrument, yet going and lifting are chief perceptions of action.

[tal-a09-v259] Again, action is a quality; in the grammarian view, action is preceded by an instrument through pervasion.

[tal-a09-v260] Knowledge is not taking; therefore action organs are chiefly called skin and so on, pervading their fields.
chunks.sanskrit: [and]-ata eva vihīne@pi buddhikarmendriyaiḥ kvacit / andhe paṅgau rūpagatiprakāśo na na bhāsate kiṃtu sāmānyakaraṇabalādvedye@pi tādṛśi / rūpasāmānya evāndhaḥ pratipattiṃ prapadyate tata eva tvahaṃkārāt tanmātrasparśino@dhikam / karmendriyāṇi vākpāṇipāyūpasthāṅghri jajñire vacmyādade tyajāmyāśu visṛjāmi vrajāmi ca / iti yāhaṃkriyā kāryakṣamā karmendriyaṃ tu tat tena cchinnakarasyāsti hastaḥ karmendriyātmakaḥ / tasya pradhānādhiṣṭhānaṃ paraṃ pañcāṅguliḥ karaḥ mukhenāpi yadādānaṃ tatra yat karaṇaṃ sthitam / sa pāṇireva karaṇaṃ vinā kiṃ saṃbhavet kriyā tathābhāve tu buddhyakṣairapi kiṃ syātprayojanam / darśanaṃ karaṇāpekṣaṃ kriyātvāditi cocyate parairgamau tu karaṇaṃ neṣyate ceti vismayaḥ / gamanotkṣepaṇādīni mukhyaṃ karmopalambhanam punarguṇaḥ kriyā tveṣā vaiyākaraṇadarśane / kriyā karaṇapūrveti vyāptyā karaṇapūrvakam jñānaṃ nādānamityetat sphuṭamāndhyavijṛmbhitam / tasmāt karmendriyāṇyāhustvagvadvyāptṝṇi mukhyataḥ

chunks.l2:
[tal-a09-v261] My teachers in Matanga say they have function in place, and many other actions exist for that.

[tal-a09-v262] Instruments are also to be stated; non-fixity in senses is refuted by guardians and others, not actions.

[tal-a09-v263] Whatever means would be a sense, but this is to calm the thirst of questioning.

[tal-a09-v264] Peacocks are not satisfied by clear water; here my answer is taught by Shambhu.

[tal-a09-v265] Made powerful by clear-perception noble-deficiency — here, one from action-investigation difference is divided.

[tal-a09-v266] There connection is five-souled — from five action-organs, for relinquishment-acquisition-prosperity, for the pair the pair, without.

[tal-a09-v267] For resting in own nature, fourfold action, external — anus hands feet genitals; organ, that fourfold.

[tal-a09-v268] End, prana-support — but which action here is instrument indeed: speech. Said in summary, and of these various in effects are functions.

[tal-a09-v269] Distinct from this indeed no action anywhere is seen — for what purpose postulate this instability of senses?

[tal-a09-v270] This duty-wheel they perform by that non-confusion — senses by co-functioning, but perceive confusion, the dull.
chunks.sanskrit: [and]-tatsthāne vṛttimantīti mataṅge guravo mama / nanvanyānyapi karmāṇi santi bhūyāṃsi tatkṛte karaṇānyapi vācyāni tathā cākṣeṣvaniṣṭhitiḥ / nanvetat kheṭapālādyairnirākāri na karmaṇām yatsādhanaṃ tadakṣaṃ syāt kiṃtu kasyāpi karmaṇaḥ / etannāsmatkṛtapraśnatṛṣṇāsaṃtāpaśāntaye nahyasvacchamitaprāyairjalaistṛpyanti barhiṇaḥ / ucyate śrīmatādiṣṭaṃ śaṃbhunātra mamottaram svacchasaṃvedanodāravikalāprabalīkṛtam / iha karmānusaṃdhānabhedādekaṃ vibhidyate tatrānusaṃdhiḥ pañcātmā pañca karmendriyāṇyataḥ / tyāgāyādānasaṃpattyai dvayāya dvitayaṃ vinā svarūpaviśrāntikṛte caturdhā karma yadbahiḥ / pāyupāṇyaṅghrijananaṃ karaṇaṃ taccaturvidham antaṃ prāṇāśrayaṃ yattu karmātra karaṇaṃ hi vāk / uktāḥ samāsataścaiṣāṃ citrāḥ kāryeṣu vṛttayaḥ tadetadvyatiriktaṃ hi na karma kvāpi dṛśyate / tatkasyārthe prakalpyeyamindriyāṇāmaniṣṭhitiḥ etatkartavyacakraṃ tadasāṃkaryeṇa kurvate / akṣāṇi sahavṛttyā tu buddhyante saṃkaraṃ jaḍāḥ

chunks.l2:
[tal-a09-v271] Said: sense-group from egoism, but from rajas — from tamas-predominant egoism, of enjoyer-portion-covering nature.

[tal-a09-v272] The five tanmatras named from bhuta, cause of gross elements — mind intellect sense action-organs group, tanmatra group.

[tal-a09-v273] Thus here rajas-ego-yoga is connector in the two — others call mind born from rajas-ego, because.

[tal-a09-v274] Skilled in all-sense movement, light, speedy — others: from sattvic, mind; but intellect-action-organs.

[tal-a09-v275] From rajas, grasper-grasped-portion-touching, they think — planet-guardians think action-organ group, clearly.

[tal-a09-v276] Born of rajas-ego, for rajas is action-ness, because — in Sripurva scripture mind from rajas, but from sattvic again.

[tal-a09-v277] All senses fittingly — and this shines to us; for thus, of external-function senses, in function-shining.

[tal-a09-v278] In perceiving, power in inner joining, of mind again — as said by the guru, mind would do following-discrimination, true.

[tal-a09-v279] That-duality-supported, mother-activity-essence action, thus — but the tanmatra group, of darkness-predominant ego.

[tal-a09-v280] Here no dispute of all: graspable beginning indeed — in earth, fragrant-variegated, in smell-sphere.
chunks.sanskrit: [and]-ukta indriyavargo@yamahaṃkārāt tu rājasāt / tamaḥpradhānāhaṃkārād bhoktraṃśacchādanātmanaḥ bhūtādināmnastanmātrapañcakaṃ bhūtakāraṇam / manobuddhyakṣakarmākṣavargastanmātravargakaḥ ityatra rājasāhaṃkṛdyogaḥ saṃśleṣako dvaye / anye tvāhurmano jātaṃ rājasāhaṃkṛteryataḥ samastendriyasaṃcāracaturaṃ laghu vegavat / anye tu sāttvikāt svāntaṃ buddhikarmendriyāṇi tu rājasādgrāhakagrāhyabhāgasparśīni manvate / kheṭapālāstu manyante karmendriyagaṇaḥ sphuṭam rājasāhaṃkṛterjāto rajasaḥ karmatā yataḥ / śrīpūrvaśāstre tu mano rājasāt sāttvikātpunaḥ indriyāṇi samastāni yuktaṃ caitadvibhāti naḥ / tathāhi bāhyavṛttīnāmakṣāṇāṃ vṛttibhāsane ālocane śaktirantaryojane manasaḥ punaḥ / uktaṃ ca guruṇā kuryānmano@nuvyavasāyi sat taddvayālambanā mātṛvyāpārātmakriyā iti / tānmātrastu gaṇo dhvāntapradhānāyā ahaṃkṛteḥ atrāvivādaḥ sarvasya grāhyopakrama eva hi / pṛthivyāṃ saurabhānyādivicitre gandhamaṇḍale

chunks.l2:
[tal-a09-v281] Which commonality indeed is smell-ness, named smell-tanmatra — that pervasive, therefore so said; but because of having a cause, not permanent.

[tal-a09-v282] In its own cause, obscuration-destruction — that by which not impermanent; thus in taste-to-sound tanmatras too, connection.

[tal-a09-v283] Of particulars, because controlled, the prior-undifferentiated state — agitated sound-tanmatra bearing varied-form ears.

[tal-a09-v284] Space, sound-openness-natured, spoken-superimposition-associated, because — from that-touch-tanmatra union agitation arrived.

[tal-a09-v285] Air-ness attains; by that here sound-touch-both-nature-ness — others say sound, ether-one-quality; that too is appropriate.

[tal-a09-v286] Because air attains its own form not without ether — in ever-higher elements, because prior-prior abiding.

[tal-a09-v287] From that indeed non-separation of air and ether mutually is said — sound and touch, with form together, attained agitation.

[tal-a09-v288] Fire-tattva by three dharmas, they say, as before indeed — by those three, moist waters; earth with smell, thus the order.

[tal-a09-v289] There directly established, earth-beginning quality-accumulation — not indeed smell-beginning quality-flood distinct shines earth.

[tal-a09-v290] As for quality-possessor-duality proponents even that one — variegated form on cloth shines; gradually qualities, so on earth.
chunks.sanskrit: [and]-yatsāmānyaṃ hi gandhatvaṃ gandhatanmātranāma tat / vyāpakaṃ tata evoktaṃ sahetutvāttu na dhruvam svakāraṇe tirobhūtirdhvaso yattena nādhruvam / evaṃ rasādiśabdāntatanmātreṣvapi yojanā viśeṣāṇāṃ yato@vaśyaṃ daśā prāgaviśeṣiṇī / kṣubhitaṃ śabdatanmātraṃ citrākārāḥ śratīrdadhat nabhaḥ śabdo@vakāśātmā vācyādhyāsasaho yataḥ / tadetatsparśatanmātrayogāt prakṣobhamāgatam vāyutāmeti tenātra śabdasparśobhayātmatā / anye tvāhurdhvaniḥ khaikaguṇastadapi yujyate yato vāyurnijaṃ rūpaṃ labhate na vināmbarāt / uttarottarabhūteṣu pūrvapūrvasthitiryataḥ tata eva marudvyomnoraviyogo mithaḥ smṛtaḥ / śabdasparśau tu rūpeṇa samaṃ prakṣobhamāgatau tejastattvaṃ tribhirdharmaiḥ prāhuḥ pūrvavadeva tat / taistribhiḥ sarasairāpaḥ sagandhairbhūriti kramaḥ tatra pratyakṣataḥ siddho dharādiguṇasaṃcayaḥ / nahi gandhādidharmaughavyatiriktā vibhāti bhūḥ yathā guṇaguṇidvaitavādināmekamapyadaḥ / citraṃ rūpaṃ paṭe bhāti kramāddharmāstathā bhuvi

chunks.l2:
[tal-a09-v291] As in spread cloth simultaneously shines many-coloredness — so too of yogins, by dharma-totality shines earth.

[tal-a09-v292] Smell-etc.-sound-varied-form earth — from that this shines by means-difference, by sequential-nonsequential division.

[tal-a09-v293] From that, sequence-manifestation-made intellect-difference is called — sixth-case employment, from intellect-difference distinguisher-distinguished-ness, thus.

[tal-a09-v294] By that, beyond qualities here, substance called — not anyone; there many kinds would be smell form taste in earth.

[tal-a09-v295] Touch, cooking-born hot-cold, sound variegated — whiteness, in sweetness-coldness, variegated sounds in water.

[tal-a09-v296] White-bright-hotness, variegated sounds in fire — uncooked-born cold-hot, sound-variegated in air.

[tal-a09-v297] Letter-natured sound, sound-reflections otherwise in sky — but what lacks touch-possessing quality, sound and the rest, so said.

[tal-a09-v298] By Kanada's, contradictory to self-perception — by whom grasped? In drum, sound only appears unrefuted only, that.

[tal-a09-v299] Not by mere causality, from knowledge of taking that — the ear, in our view, ego-caused; there there, that.

[tal-a09-v300] Function-share thus, that place, sound grasps sufficiently — so, he who says ear-space, ear-contact-divided.
chunks.sanskrit: [and]-yathā ca vistṛte vastre yugapadbhāti citratā / tathaiva yogināṃ dharmasāmastyenāvabhāti bhūḥ gandhādiśabdaparyantacitrarūpā dharā tataḥ / upāyabhedādbhātyeṣā kramākramavibhāgataḥ tata eva kramavyaktikṛto dhībheda ucyate / ṣaṣṭhīprayogo dhībhedādbhedyabhedakatā tathā tena dharmātirikto@tra dharmī nāma na kaścana / tatrānekaprakārāḥ syurgandharūparasāḥ kṣitau saṃsparśaḥ pākajo@nuṣṇāśītaḥ śabdo vicitrakaḥ / śauklyaṃ mādhuryaśītatve citrāḥ śabdāśca vāriṇi śuklabhāsvaratoṣṇatvaṃ citrāḥ śabdāśca pāvake / apākajaścāśītoṣṇo dhvaniścitraśca mārute varṇātmako dhvaniḥ śabdapratibimbānyathāmbare / yattu na sparśavaddharmaḥ śabda ityādi bhaṇyate kāṇādaistatsvapratītiviruddhaṃ kena gṛhyatām / paṭahe dhvanirityeva bhātyabādhitameva yat na ca hetutvamātreṇa tadādānatvavedanāt / śrotraṃ cāsmanmate@haṃkṛtkāraṇaṃ tatra tatra tat vṛttibhāgīti taddeśaṃ śabdaṃ gṛhṇātyalaṃ tathā / yastvāha śrotramākāśaṃ karṇasaṃyogabheditam

chunks.l2:
[tal-a09-v301] Sound-born cognition arises when sound comes; even a faint drum sound, if heard, counts.

[tal-a09-v302] How can perception occur at a distance? Not so: sound-born sound is uttered from far and far.

[tal-a09-v303] What is in ear-space has far-and-far nature; that first sound is not pervasive, and this is fitting.

[tal-a09-v304] With those there, the intense-natured is heard by this; but how would the faint be heard? Not so, since it rests on another quality.

[tal-a09-v305] This was refuted by others in many ways; vain again. Who indeed is not a scholar in giving a blow to the fallen?

[tal-a09-v306] But of these, earth and the rest, as many tattva-group as before, standing by greater quality, pervaded, so much shines.

[tal-a09-v307] The pervaded-pervader relation shown of the tattvas is established by greater quality, not by causality nor by simplicity.

[tal-a09-v308] Even without cause, attachment is clearly pervaded by knowing and so forth; without that, what is called pervaded would not be, since.

[tal-a09-v309] No simplicity indeed exists here in own view; by greater quality the pervaded-pervader relation is known clearly.

[tal-a09-v310] Who indeed is superior in quality from that is called above; aboveness is pervader-ness, clear in Sri Malinivijaya.
chunks.sanskrit: [and]-śabdajaḥ śabda āgatya śabdabuddhiṃ prasūyate / tasya mande@pi murajadhvanāvākarṇake sati amutra śrutireṣeti dūre saṃvedanaṃ katham / nahi śabdajaśabdasya dūrādūraravoditeḥ śrotrākāśagatasyāsti dūrādūrasvabhāvatā / na cāsau prathamaḥ śabdastāvadvyāpīti yujyate tatrasthaiḥ saha tīvrātmā śrūyamāṇastvanena tu / kathaṃ śrūyeta mandaḥsannahi dharmāntarāśrayaḥ etaccānyairapākāri bahudheti vṛthā punaḥ / nāyastaṃ patitāghātadāne ko hi na paṇḍitaḥ amīṣāṃ tu dharādīnāṃ yāvāṃstattvagaṇaḥ purā / guṇādhikatayā tiṣṭhan vyāptā tāvān prakāśate vyāpyavyāpakatā yaiṣā tattvānāṃ darśitā kila / sā guṇādhikyataḥ siddhā na hetutvānna lāghavāt ahetunāpi rāgo hi vyāpto vidyādinā sphuṭam / tadvinā na bhavedyattadvyāptamityucyate yataḥ na lāghavaṃ ca nāmāsti kiṃcidatra svadarśane / guṇādhikyādato jñeyā vyāpyavyāpakatā sphuṭā yo hi yasmādguṇotkṛṣṭaḥ sa tasmādūrdhva ucyate / ūrdhvatā vyāptṛtā śrīmanmālinīvijaye sphuṭā

chunks.l2:
[tal-a09-v311] Therefore from Sivahood taking light-nature in own self, earth shines with all tattva-chain qualities; pervader-ness is established enough.

[tal-a09-v312] Thus for water and so forth up to Sakti-tattva abode form exists such; but higher is Sakti-tattva, lower is its quality, difference.

[tal-a09-v313] This has been shown in the supreme procedure by vaitatya; therefore the discerning one who desires expansion should look further.

[tal-a09-v314] Thus the form of tattva has been properly illuminated.
chunks.sanskrit: [and]-ataḥ śivatvātprabhṛti prakāśatāsvarūpamādāya nijātmani dhruvam / samastatattvāvalidharmasaṃcayairvibhāti bhūrvyāptṛtayā sthitairalam evaṃ jalāderapi śaktitattvaparyantadhāmno vapurasti tādṛk / kiṃ tūttaraṃ śaktitayaiva tattvaṃ pūrva tu taddharmatayeti bhedaḥ anuttaraprakriyāyāṃ vaitatyena pradarśitam / etat tasmāt tataḥ paśyedvistarārthī vivecakaḥ iti tattvasyarūpasya kṛtaṃ samyak prakāśanam
